_description: OCI MI300X cluster (SLURM cluster m2m). Allocation defaults for the multinode launchers, in madengine --additional-context format: pass this file as --additional-context-file, or read its slurm block for the sbatch options when submitting a launcher yourself. Facts the job needs once it is running (filesystems, fabric, ports) are in ../cluster.sh. docker_build_arg names the cluster's GPU for image builds that compile per arch; an arch the CI probes or is given overrides it.
